mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1.5% simultaneously and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.
